title: CM Revanth lays foundation for ₹60,000-crore Amazon data centre
description: Telangana chief minister A Revanth Reddy on Tuesday laid the foundation stone for a ₹60,000-crore data centre being set up by software giant Amazon at Bharat Future City on the outskirts of Hyderabad, saying the project would act as a major catalyst in attracting global investments to the state
